result.summary: The page is mostly well-formed, but there are a few visible defects: a nonsensical '–0%' discount badge, a truncated restaurant name, and a partially clipped category chip with no visible label.

issues.description: The pizza restaurant card in 'Popular right now' displays a '–0%' discount badge, which is meaningless — a 0% discount should not be shown as a promotion.
issues.suggestion: Hide the discount badge when the discount value is 0, or fix the data source so the correct discount percentage is rendered.

issues.description: The third card in 'Fastest near you' shows a truncated restaurant name ('Trattoria Piccol...') without an ellipsis or clear truncation treatment, appearing cut off at the screen edge.
issues.suggestion: Apply proper text truncation with an ellipsis inside the card bounds, or ensure the carousel peek reveals enough of the card so the name isn't awkwardly clipped.

issues.description: The category chip after 'Healthy' is clipped at the right edge and shows no visible label, making it look like an empty/broken pill rather than an intentional carousel peek.
issues.suggestion: Adjust the horizontal scroll peek so part of the next chip's label is visible, or add a fade/gradient at the edge to signal there is more content to scroll.

issues.description: Delivery cost information is inconsistent in emphasis: 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' shows '€0 delivery' both as a badge and in the metadata line, which is redundant.
issues.suggestion: Show the free-delivery indicator in one place (e.g., only the badge) to reduce visual noise.
